episode_title: ConPulse | How to Launch Your Brand In the Middle East Market with Shan Abdul Salam, Founder & CEO at Swish.

real_qa.q: What are the top growth opportunities and consumer behaviors when launching a brand in the Middle East market?
real_qa.r: The Middle East market has huge opportunity with high purchasing power consumers. Unlike US, China, or India, the market is smaller but consumers earn more and don't mind spending additional money to buy online. Key differences include time-saving preference: instead of spending 4-5 hours in malls, consumers can get delivery within 1-2 hours in UAE, Qatar, and Bahrain. People are willing to pay delivery charges even for short distances. The opportunity is still largely untapped with many brands focusing offline rather than online.
real_qa.requete: Middle East ecommerce market opportunities consumer behavior

real_qa.q: How should new brands entering the Middle East market build distribution partnerships without local presence?
real_qa.r: Use the friends and family route to find connections in offline stores and hypermarkets. Get introduced to major clients of distributors, then connect with the distributor directly. BNI (Business Network International) is a very popular network group in the Middle East similar to Rotary in India—tapping into BNI networks can unlock partnership opportunities. The key is that everything runs on contacts and relationships; finding the right distributor who already has warehouse setup, manpower, and supermarket chain connections saves time and money.
real_qa.requete: how to find distributor Middle East market BNI network

real_qa.q: What is the WhatsApp strategy for customer engagement and review collection in Middle East ecommerce?
real_qa.r: After customer purchase, send review requests via WhatsApp. This strategy has shown 15% personal conversion rate compared to email's 1% conversion rate—for every 100 review requests sent via WhatsApp, at least 15 replies are received. People browse WhatsApp more than Google and receive constant notifications. Replies are almost always positive 5-star reviews with detailed feedback on delivery, customer service quality, and product satisfaction, allowing brands to understand what's working and double down on strengths.
real_qa.requete: WhatsApp customer review strategy Middle East ecommerce conversion rate

real_qa.q: What are the recommended categories and initial focus areas for new brand launches in the Middle East?
real_qa.r: Pet care is identified as a huge market with extremely high consumer spending. Pet owners are ready to spend anything on their pets. While the market is small in population, the buying power and spending capacity of pet owners is enormous. Beyond category selection, focus on influencer marketing with influencers who match your brand's vision and have regional influence, and build partnerships with distributors for offline visibility in major hypermarkets and supermarkets.
real_qa.requete: pet care category Middle East ecommerce market opportunity

real_qa.q: How should Indian D2C brands scale into the Middle East without establishing a full local team?
real_qa.r: Find one resource who knows the market and has done it before—that resource solves everything else. Identify a distributor for offline stocking and online presence support. The brand already knows digital marketing and D2C operations from India, so leverage existing capabilities: a small warehouse team can pack and send via logistics partners for 1-2 hour delivery, while after-sales support and customer service can be handled from India using existing call center teams. This approach minimizes cash burn in the initial phase.
real_qa.requete: scale Indian D2C brand to Middle East without local team

real_qa.q: What government policy and payment gateway challenges exist for ecommerce businesses in Middle East regions?
real_qa.r: Government policies and regulations in the Middle East are generally favorable and not a major delay factor. However, payment gateway experiences vary significantly: Dubai has very good payment gateway user experience, while Saudi Arabia and Qatar have payment gateway challenges and triple verification steps. Overall, the government is receptive and regulations are easy to work with once entrepreneurs find the right resource to navigate them.
real_qa.requete: Middle East payment gateway regulations Dubai Saudi Arabia Qatar

He then ventured into e-commerce with Karen Khyor, scaling the brand from zero to profitability within three years while also building several apps in the Shopify App Store.
